leaves.originalObligation: - [ ] A-E-07 Reconcile original `E-07`: Review rich-content rendering and trust boundaries; do not render arbitrary HTML or unsafe links merely because they arrived in a presentation model. Saved/pasted link destinations are governed by the [owned policy](react-aria-editor-section.md#link-destination-policy-e-06e-07-partial), and image decoration by the [image source policy](react-aria-editor-section.md#image-source-policy-e-06e-07-partial); broader rich-content acceptance remains open. Historical status: open.
leaves.decision: Owned link/image rendering, runtime metadata checks, escaped React attributes and JSON fidelity are bounded protection. Saved rejected destinations remain raw data; editor rendering is not a downstream sanitizer. No atomic whole-document/style policy exists.
remainingConcreteSuccessors: W04-07-TRUST: Owner defines author CSS/property/resource allowlist, malformed/unknown node/version recovery and downstream renderer policies. Then run hostile saved/pasted CSS/resource corpus with native request/geometry observations and original-retention assertions. Reuse wave-03-26 trust-review.md; do not purge author styles without a decision.
